true_findings.title: Icon-only search button has no accessible name
Email field collecting the user's own address has no autocomplete (input purpose not programmatically identified)
true_findings.notes: type=text with no autocomplete on a newsletter signup collecting the user's own email — an enumerated 1.3.5 input purpose, so the token is required. Attribute absence is a DOM fact and 'the user's own email' is unambiguous for a subscribe form, so ● is the honest basis (a ◐ hedge is also acceptable, never an over-claim). Engine gap, not engine pass: the engine's only 1.3.5 rule (adaptable/autocomplete-valid) validates values when the attribute is present and never requires it.
